ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Five JK flip-flops are cascaded to form the circuit shown in the image. Clock pulses at a frequency of 1 MHz are applied as shown. The frequency (in kHz) of the waveform at \( Q3 \) is _____.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are five cascaded JK flip-flops, with outputs labeled in order as Q0, Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4; the J and K inputs of each flip-flop are all connected as 1. The external clock pulse is connected into the first stage, and the subsequent stages are driven by the output of the preceding stage, forming a ripple frequency-division chain. Reasoning: When J=K=1, the JK flip-flop toggles once on each active clock edge, so each stage divides the frequency by 2. The input clock is 1 MHz, so Q0 = 1 MHz/2, Q1 = 1 MHz/4, Q2 = 1 MHz/8, Q3 = 1 MHz/16 = 0.0625 MHz = 62.5 kHz.

method.method_draft: From the image, identify the flip-flops as a ripple chain with J=K=1 for every stage. Use the text value f_clock = 1 MHz. Compute successively: Q0 = 1 MHz/2, Q1 = 1 MHz/4, Q2 = 1 MHz/8, Q3 = 1 MHz/16 = 0.0625 MHz = 62.5 kHz.

method.method_draft: Interpret the displayed cascade as a 5-bit asynchronous binary counter. Since Q3 is bit index 3 when Q0 is the least significant bit, Q3 has one full cycle every 2^(3+1)=16 input clock pulses. With the text-given input clock of 1 MHz, calculate f_Q3 = 1 MHz/16 = 62.5 kHz.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：附图中可以看到5个JK触发器级联排列，输出标号为Q0、Q1、Q2、Q3、Q4；每个触发器的J、K端都接为逻辑1，因此每一级JK触发器在被触发时都会翻转。右下方标有clock的脉冲输入加到第一级，后续各级由前一级输出级联，构成5位异步二进制计数器。推理：在这种计数器中，每一级触发器都把输入到该级的频率二分频。若Q0为最低位，则Q0频率为输入时钟的1/2，Q1为1/4，Q2为1/8，Q3为1/16。输入时钟频率为1 MHz = 1000 kHz，所以Q3频率 = 1000/16 = 62.5 kHz。
